DECLARE @CDATE DATETIME = GETDATE()

SELECT DATEADD(DAY,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,@CDATE) >=23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,DATEADD(DAY,CASE WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,@CDATE) = 2 THEN -3 WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,@CDATE) = 1 THEN -2 ELSE -1 END,CONVERT(DATE,@CDATE)))
IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##tmpCGTEXT') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##tmpCGTEXT

CREATE TABLE ##tmpCGTEXT (
    [CALL_ID] bigint,
    [MBR_CALL_ID] bigint,
    [CMPGN_YEAR_NBR] int,
    [HC_ID] varchar(30),
    [MBR_FRST_NM] varchar(20),
    [MBR_M_I] varchar(1),
    [MBR_LAST_NM] varchar(40),
    [CMS_CNTRCT_NBR] varchar(5),
    [SRC_CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID] varchar(3),
    [BRND_LOGO_DESC] varchar(200),
    [PRMRY_PHONE_NBR] varchar(20),
    [CALL_DTM] varchar(25),
    [CALL_ATMT_NBR] int,
    [DIALER_DISP_CD] varchar(10),
    [DIALER_DISP_CD_DESC] varchar(200),
    [DISPOSITION_ID] varchar(200),
    [DISPOSITION_ID_DESC] varchar(10),
    [MBR_EFCTV_DT] varchar(10),
    [MBR_TRMNTN_DT] varchar(10),
    [DENRLMNT_IND_CD] int,
    [DSNP_IND] int,
)

DECLARE @CALLLIST_DATE DATETIME = @QueryDate

IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TMP1') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TMP1
CREATE TABLE #TMP1 (CALLLIST_IID BIGINT,MEMBER_IID BIGINT)
INSERT INTO #TMP1 (CALLLIST_IID,MEMBER_IID) 
SELECT DISTINCT CL.CALLLIST_IID,CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID
FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL
INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID
	AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = '704'
	AND CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)) = @CALLLIST_DATE
INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID
INNER JOIN PDS_CALL C ON C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID
	AND CONVERT(DATE,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME) = @CALLLIST_DATE

IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpCalls') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmpCalls
CREATE TABLE #tmpCalls (MEMBER_HCID VARCHAR(100),CALL_IID BIGINT,CALL_CALLDATETIME DATETIME,ATTEMPT INT)

INSERT INTO #tmpCalls (MEMBER_HCID,CALL_IID,CALL_CALLDATETIME,ATTEMPT)
SELECT M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_HCID, 
	C.CALL_IID,
	C.CALL_CALLDATETIME,
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_HCID ORDER BY C.CALL_CALLDATETIME) AS ATTEMPTS
FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CLD	
		ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CLD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID
	INNER JOIN #TMP1 T
		ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = T.CALLLIST_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CLM
		ON CLD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CLM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID
		AND CLM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = T.MEMBER_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALL C
		ON C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CLM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CLS
		ON CLM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = CLS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID
		AND CLS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID
		AND C.CALL_CALLDATETIME >= CLS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT
	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_GENESYS_DISPOSITIONCODE_LOOKUP DL
	ON DL.CALLLIST_CD=CL.CALLLIST_CD
	AND DL.GENESYSCODE=DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD
	AND CASE WHEN ISNULL(C.CALL_AGENT ,'') ='' THEN 'SYSTEM' ELSE 'AGENT' END=DL.DISPOSITIONED_BY
	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONGROUP DG ON 
		DL.DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID = DG.DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID	
	INNER JOIN PDS_CAREGUIDE_MEMBER M ON CLS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID = M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_IID
WHERE DG.DISPOSITIONGROUP_CD <> 'NONATTEMPT' --Added for SNOW-16342
		
INSERT INTO ##tmpCGTEXT (CALL_ID,MBR_CALL_ID,CMPGN_YEAR_NBR,HC_ID,MBR_FRST_NM,MBR_M_I,MBR_LAST_NM,CMS_CNTRCT_NBR,SRC_CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID,BRND_LOGO_DESC,PRMRY_PHONE_NBR,CALL_DTM,CALL_ATMT_NBR,DIALER_DISP_CD,DIALER_DISP_CD_DESC,DISPOSITION_ID,DISPOSITION_ID_DESC,MBR_EFCTV_DT,MBR_TRMNTN_DT,DENRLMNT_IND_CD,DSNP_IND)
SELECT C.CALL_IID AS CALL_ID,
C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID AS MBR_CALL_ID,
DATEPART(YEAR,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME) AS CMPGN_YEAR_NBR,
M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_HCID AS HC_ID,
M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_FirstName AS MBR_FRST_NM,
M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_MiddleInitial AS MBR_M_I,
M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_LastName AS MBR_LAST_NM,
M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_Contract AS CMS_CNTRCT_NBR,
M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PBP AS SRC_CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID,
M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_Brand AS BRND_LOGO_DESC,
M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber AS PRMRY_PHONE_NBR,
CONVERT(VARCHAR,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME,101) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME,108) AS CALL_DTM,
TC.ATTEMPT AS CALL_ATMT_NBR,
DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD AS DIALER_DISP_CD,
DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION AS DIALER_DISP_CD_DESC,
L.DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID AS DISPOSITION_ID,
DG.DISPOSITIONGROUP_CD AS DISPOSITION_ID_DESC,
CONVERT(VARCHAR,M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_EligibilityStartDate,101) AS MBR_EFCTV_DT,
CONVERT(VARCHAR,M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_EligibilityEndDate,101) AS MBR_TRMNTN_DT,
CASE WHEN GETDATE() > M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_EligibilityEndDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DENRLMNT_IND_CD,
M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_DSNPFlag AS DSNP_IND
FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID
		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = '704'
		AND CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)) = @CALLLIST_DATE
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALL C ON C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID
		AND CONVERT(DATE,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME) = @CALLLIST_DATE
	INNER JOIN PDS_CAREGUIDE_MEMBER M ON M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_GENESYS_DISPOSITIONCODE_LOOKUP L ON L.CALLLIST_CD = CL.CALLLIST_CD
		AND L.GENESYSCODE = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD
		AND L.DISPOSITIONED_BY = CASE WHEN C.CALL_AGENT IS NULL OR C.CALL_AGENT = '' THEN 'SYSTEM' ELSE 'AGENT' END
	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONGROUP DG ON DG.DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID = L.DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID
	LEFT OUTER JOIN #tmpCalls TC ON TC.CALL_IID = C.CALL_IID
WHERE M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_IID <> 1262361
IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##tmpCGTEXT') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##tmpCGTEXT
IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##tmpCGTEXT') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##tmpCGTEXT
